firstPlayerRule: Give the first-player token to the player who looks the most nervous.
clarifications: The first-player token is also used to finish the current round so everyone receives the same number of turns.

sources.title: Chakra English rulebook

internalEvidence: Visually checked the publisher-authored English rules mirrored by 1jour-1jeu. Printed page 2 assigns the token to the most nervous-looking player; the later end-of-game section uses the token to finish equal turns. The booklet credits Luka Krleža and Claire Conan and identifies Blam!, matching inventory BGG 267378. SHA-256: 4df203130f0be35aac460daf5fd3384359194bde8ce79c69cc00125da3c659d0. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22. Editorial review 2026-09-24: Rechecked identity, first-player selection, and relevant later-round or variant instructions against the cited pages.
uncertainty: The most-nervous criterion is subjective and the source gives no tie procedure.
